title: Odile and the Parish
author: Lena Ishikawa
blurb: Wendell Marchetti, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
